omar: Hey all  first day, trying to build runtime from source. Running `./scripts/build.sh --cuda --release` and nvcc immediately errors out. Any tips? @linda

linda: welcome! :wave: Can you paste `nvcc --version`, `gcc --version`, and the full nvcc error?

omar: nvcc:
``nVCC: NVIDIA (R) Cuda compiler driver
Cuda compilation tools, release 12.1, V12.1.105
```

gcc:
``gcc (Debian 13.1.0-2) 13.1.0
```

nvcc error:
``nvcc fatal   : Unsupported GNU version! gcc versions later than 11 are not supported
CMake Error at cmake/FindCUDA.cmake:1210 (message):
  ptxas died with status 1
```

linda: yeah that message is pretty common when the installed NVCC/toolkit doesn't support the host compiler. Two quick options: install gcc-11 and point cmake at it, or use our dev docker image which has a compatible toolchain.

paige: i usually do this for dev machines:
``sudo apt install gcc-11 g++-11
export CC=/usr/bin/gcc-11
export CXX=/usr/bin/g++-11
rm -rf build && ./scripts/build.sh --cuda --release
```
That avoids changing system alternatives. Also update `cmake` invocation if you run it directly: `-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=/usr/bin/gcc-11 -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/usr/bin/g++-11`.

alex: note: CI uses images with gcc-11 for CUDA 12.1 rows. If you plan to build a lot locally, you can add a small toolchain note to your shell rc, but for onboarding we prefer recommending the docker image to reduce host variance.

infra-bot: FYI  recommended dev image: redwood/dev:cuda-12-toolchain (contains CUDA 12.1 + gcc-11 and matching cuDNN). Use for parity with CI.

omar: Tried installing gcc-11 and exported CC/CXX like above. Cleaned the build dir and re-ran; got past that error but then hit a cudnn symbol mismatch (had old cuDNN libs in /usr/local/cuda/lib64). Pulled the dev docker image and rebuilt inside container  build succeeded! :tada:

omar: I'll open a tiny PR adding a short note to docs/dev-setup.md: "If nvcc errors about unsupported GNU version, install gcc-11 and point CMAKE_C_COMPILER/CXX to it, or use redwood/dev:cuda-12-toolchain." Will tag `chore(dev): document nvcc gcc compatibility` and ping dev-experience.

linda: perfect  thanks for doing that. Welcome aboard and ping if you hit anything else!
